subject: Mathematics
title: Class 9 Mathematics Olympiad — Paper 5
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Arrange in ascending order: 3/4, 0.6, 5/8, 0.7
A is west of B. C is north of B. What direction is C from A?
If SOUTH becomes NORTH when reflected, what does EAST become?
A clock shows 2:00. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
Find the next term: 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, __ (Fibonacci-like pattern)
If '×' means '+', '÷' means '-', '+' means '×', evaluate: 4 ÷ 2 × 3
Complete the analogy: Triangle is to 3 sides as Pentagon is to ____
A is the daughter of B. C is the son of A. How is B related to C?
Find the missing number: 3, 7, 15, 31, __
Find the odd one out: Square, Rectangle, Rhombus, Circle
options: Circle (has no straight sides, others are quadrilaterals)

questions.question: If 4 painters can paint a house in 6 days, how many days will 8 painters take?
Five friends sit in a circle. Raj sits opposite Priya. Simran sits between Raj and Aman. Who sits opposite Simran?
options: Cannot be determined without knowing the fifth person's position, but likely between Priya and Aman

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, __
If in a code, BOOK is written as CPPL, how is PAGE written?
Statement: All squares are rectangles. All rectangles are quadrilaterals. Conclusion: All squares are quadrilaterals.
Find the total surface area of a cube with side 4 cm.
What is the class mark (mid-value) of the class interval 10-20?
Find the area of a triangle with sides 5 cm, 6 cm, and 7 cm using Heron's formula (s=9).
Factorize: x^2 - 9
According to Euclid's postulates, how many lines can pass through two distinct points?
Find the volume of a cuboid with dimensions 5cm x 4cm x 3cm.
Find the value of the polynomial p(x) = x^2 - 5x + 6 at x = 2.
What is the sum of all interior angles of a quadrilateral?
What is the mean of the data: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50?
A coin is tossed once. What is the probability of getting a tail?
A chord of a circle divides it into how many arcs?
Solve for x: 2x + 5 = 15
What are the coordinates of the origin?
What is the degree of the polynomial 3x^3 + 2x^2 - x + 7?
Is the number 7/2 a rational or irrational number?
options: Irrational, as it cannot be expressed as p/q
Rational, as it can be expressed as p/q

questions.question: Simplify: sqrt(50) in simplest radical form.
What is the sum of the interior angles of a triangle?
In a parallelogram, opposite sides are:
If two lines intersect, the vertically opposite angles formed are:
How many solutions does a linear equation in two variables have?
If 8 books cost Rs. 480, what is the cost of 5 books?
A train travels at 72 km/h. Convert this speed to metres per second.
A shopkeeper buys an article for Rs. 500 and sells it for Rs. 600. Find the profit percentage.
A discount of 10% is given on a marked price of Rs. 1200. Find the selling price.
A tank is filled by a pipe in 8 hours. If half the tank is already full, how long will the pipe take to fill the rest?
A car covers 180 km in 3 hours. What is its speed?
A sum becomes Rs. 1200 in 2 years at simple interest of 10% per annum. Find the original principal.
A recipe uses 3 eggs for 6 servings. How many eggs are needed for 10 servings?

A wall is 8m long and 3m high. Find the cost of painting it at Rs. 20 per sq metre.

questions.question: A student is asked to prove that the diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other. Which pair of triangles should be shown congruent to establish this?
options: No triangles are needed; it follows directly from definition
The two triangles formed by one diagonal, using alternate interior angles and ASA/SAS criteria
Any two random triangles within the parallelogram
Triangles formed only by the sides, not diagonals

questions.question: In a triangle, the sum of two sides is always __ the third side, according to the triangle inequality.
Two poles of heights 6m and 11m are erected 12m apart on level ground. Using distance formula reasoning, what is the distance between their tops?
options: 13 m (since horizontal difference 12m, vertical difference 5m, hypotenuse = sqrt(12^2+5^2)=13)
